# Craftchirp Virtual Gallery & Global Marketplace

> Premium 1-of-1 original Warli and Madhubani folk art on moisture-resistant MDF with natural cow-dung base and natural mineral pigments by Indian artist-founder Rachana Agarwal (15+ years experience).

Craftchirp transforms ancestral Indian earth art into collectible, high-end gallery originals. Every piece is handmade in Maharashtra, India, using traditional multi-stage purified cow-dung slurry, alluvial clay, and natural rice pigments. The artwork is completely odorless, zero-chemical, and naturally sun-baked.

## Key Facts & Entity Definitions
- **Founder & Artist**: Rachana Agarwal (15+ years practicing living Warli and Madhubani traditions).
- **Core Traditions**:
  - **Warli**: Tribal geometric art from Maharashtra using circles (sun/moon), triangles (mountains/humans), and squares (sacred enclosures). Celebrates the Tarpa dance and agricultural harvest.
  - **Madhubani (Mithila)**: Ancient geometric ritual art from Bihar using double-line hatching (*Kachni*) and natural mineral color fills (*Bharni*).
- **Surface & Medium**: Triple-purified cow-dung slurry, fine alluvial earth clay, natural rice flour paste, lampblack charcoal, and mineral ochres on moisture-resistant high-density MDF boards.
- **Classification**: 1-of-1 Unique Originals (each with a registered Certificate of Authenticity).
- **Hypoallergenic Jewellery**: Hand-sculpted riverbed terracotta clay with verified 316L medical-grade surgical stainless steel findings.
- **Packaging Spec**: Custom rigid plywood skeletal crating, corner shock guards, and waterproof barrier.
- **Target Export Markets**: United States and European Union (with full DDP landed cost and EU 2026 customs duty compliance).
- **Russian Market Policy**: Gated inquiry-only (`RU_CHECKOUT=false`) via private gallery inquiry form.
- **Contact**: craftchirp@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/craftchirp_creations/
- **Website**: https://craftchirp.com
